pages.text: [#](53341a)An effigy shaped to resemble a person and bound to them through a taglock carries a thread of the sympathy that connects all things. What happens to the effigy tends to happen to its subject — and it works in both directions.[#]()
pages.title: Poppets

pages.text: [#](53341a)Bind a poppet by crafting it with a filled Taglock Kit, or right-click a living creature directly with the poppet. The plain Poppet is the foundation; Voodoo and Vampiric forms do the hostile work, while protection forms are carried in your inventory or kept on a Poppet Shelf.[#]()
[#](53341a)Hold and release it to throw the bound target, sneak-release with a Bone Needle to prick them, drown it to choke them, or touch it to lava to burn it out.[#]()
[#](53341a)Most protection poppets trigger when matching harm would become dire, and are consumed in the saving.[#]()
pages.title: On Protection

pages.text: [#](53341a)Death, Earth, Water, Fire, Hunger; each covers a different category of misfortune. Voodoo Protection wears down instead, turning aside hostile Voodoo and Vampiric workings and biting back at the caster.[#]() [#](53341a)Keep spares. The shelf holds nine.[#]()
